description: Queue a typed preview artifact for ONE org-installed component — ASYNC: returns a jobId immediately; then wait_job(kind="preview", id=jobId). The preview and production compositor consume the same content-addressed component bundle and verified artifact contract. `body.componentId` selects the component; pass `body.params` to render it with props (the mount's `params`); declared manifest slots are bound separately and reach the scene's `assets`, never params. Admission/runtime/capability failures land on the job terminal with sanitized author-fixable messages. Idempotent per immutable render key.

assets.description: Component asset-slot name to org mediaId. Every required manifest slot must be bound.

durationInFrames.description: Preview frame count. When omitted, uses the component's declared duration; required if the component has none.

fps.description: Preview frame rate: 24, 25, 30, or 60. When omitted, uses the project's format.

height.description: Exact height paired with width for a supported composition format.

width.description: Exact width of a supported composition format. Width and height must match one aspect ratio/resolution pair; omitted values use the project format.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

name: preview_component

jobKey.description: Deterministic identity of the work (content hash of every input the result depends on). Re-enqueueing the same key returns the same job while it runs; a failed key revives as a fresh attempt.

status.description: running on a fresh/deduped enqueue; succeeded when an identical request already completed. Cancelled is part of the shared status vocabulary; identical cancelled work revives to running.

title: Preview Component
